top_events.title: Falcon 9 Block 5 Launch for USSF-380
top_events.description: SpaceX's Falcon 9 Block 5 rocket will launch a classified mission for the United States Space Force, potentially deploying a batch of classified LEO satellites.
top_events.action: Watch the live stream on SpaceX's official website.

top_events.title: Aurora Borealis Viewing Opportunity
top_events.description: A G1-class geomagnetic storm is predicted, providing a chance to view the aurora borealis at 60° latitude.
top_events.action: Find a dark location away from city lights to view the aurora.

top_events.title: Electron Launch for Synspective
top_events.description: Rocket Lab's Electron rocket will launch a synthetic aperture radar satellite for Japanese company Synspective.
top_events.action: Follow the launch on Rocket Lab's official page.

alerts.title: Aurora Borealis Viewing Opportunity
alerts.message: A G1-class geomagnetic storm is predicted for November 26, 2026, providing a chance to view the aurora borealis at 60° latitude.
alerts.action_required: Find a dark location away from city lights to view the aurora.

opportunities.recommendation: Good viewing opportunity for high-latitude observers. Worth checking if you're above 60° latitude and skies are clear.
